description: This file defines the 'WorkshopLocation' class within the Goteo project, which manages the location data associated with workshops. It extends from a parent LocationItem class and includes methods for instantiation and retrieval based on workshop information.

classes.name: WorkshopLocation
classes.description: Represents a workshop's location, extending LocationItem with additional context related to workshops.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a WorkshopLocation instance and sets the workshop property based on the constructor arguments or existing ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkshopLocation instance associated with a given workshop object or ID.
